basics.name: Azhari Abbas
basics.label: Aerospace Engineer
basics.summary: Aerospace engineer who graduated from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in May 2026 with a B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, concentrations in Astronautics and Spacecraft Design, and completed minors in Computer Science and Business Administration. Experience in computer vision, embedded edge AI, spacecraft simulation, and engineering test.

courses: Completed minors: Computer Science and Business Administration

certificates.name: Autodesk Professional Certification – Design and Drafting

work.name: Mitsubishi Power Americas Inc.
work.summary: Analyzed operational data from high-capacity gas turbines to support product life cycle management and strategy development.
highlights: Coordinated communication between engineering, sales, and program managers across prioritization and production cycles.

work.name: Northrop Grumman Corporation
work.summary: Supported production testing on the B-21 program.
highlights: Worked with HoloLens augmented reality tools to support production test workflows.

work.name: Docking Robotics LLC
work.summary: Focused on hardware integration for autonomous ground vehicles.
highlights: Designed and integrated encoder mounting hardware.
Collaborated with vendors to resolve instrumentation and measurement system challenges.

projects.name: Navigating Enhanced Exploration Assistance (NEXA)
projects.summary: Principal Investigator for an embedded drone perception research project.
highlights: Co-led work on a dataset of 100,000+ images.
Deployed perception models on NVIDIA Jetson hardware.

projects.name: OrbitFlex CubeSat Team
projects.summary: Environmental, Test, & ConOps Engineer for a 3U CubeSat mission designed for optical space situational awareness.
highlights: Developed comprehensive end-to-end testing plans incorporating NASA GEVS Section 2.8 and vibroacoustic/shock procedures from Section 2.4.2.
Implemented ISO Class 8 cleanroom protocols for assembly and testing to ensure compliance with MIL-STD-1246C surface cleanliness standards.
Supported mission planning for line-of-sight measurements in right ascension and declination.

projects.name: Light Intensity Measurement & Validation of Radiative Laws Using Arduino
projects.summary: Designed an Arduino-based experimental setup using an LDR sensor to measure light intensity and validate physics laws.
highlights: Validated inverse-square law and Lambert’s cosine law (R² = 0.927).
Processed experimental data using custom MATLAB fitting models.

projects.name: Mixture-Ratio Sensitivity of a Hydrogen–Oxygen Rocket Engine Using NASA CEA
projects.summary: Analyzed combustion chamber temperature and specific impulse variation for a GH₂/GO₂ rocket engine.
highlights: Used NASA CEA to compare restricted chemistry and full equilibrium combustion models at 68 atm.
Identified optimal fuel-rich operating conditions (O/F ≈ 2).

projects.name: AI-Driven Collision Avoidance for Crowded Orbital Environments
projects.summary: Investigated AI-based methods for predicting and preventing satellite collisions in LEO.
highlights: Reviewed conjunction screening, event pruning, and Bayesian RNNs.
Outlined future directions for hybrid AI–physics modeling.

projects.name: Space Debris Detection for Orbital Scene Awareness
projects.summary: Developed a YOLOv8 object detection model to identify space debris and satellites in orbital imagery.
highlights: Trained on 6.4k images with 42k annotations across diverse orbital scenes.
Achieved reliable detection of small debris and large spacecraft across varying scales.

projects.name: Experimental Boundary Layer Analysis Using Hot-Wire Anemometry
projects.summary: Characterized a turbulent flat-plate boundary layer using hot-wire anemometry and pitot-static measurements.
highlights: Computed boundary layer thickness, wall shear stress, and friction coefficient.
Performed FFT analysis to evaluate turbulence intensity and kinetic energy.

projects.name: Finite Element Structural Analysis Using Simcenter Femap with NASTRAN
projects.summary: Applied FEA to classic aerospace structural problems.
highlights: Modeled beam and rod elements with isotropic aluminum material properties.
Verified model accuracy through percentage error analysis against hand calculations.

projects.name: Wind Tunnel Aerodynamic Testing of a Space Shuttle Orbiter Scale Model
projects.summary: Conducted low-speed wind tunnel testing of a 1:286 scale model.
highlights: Measured lift and drag forces across AoA from −10° to 30° at 20 m/s.
Identified peak lift coefficient (CL ≈ 1.01) and maximum L/D ≈ 1.88.

projects.name: Development of a 6DOF Flight Dynamics Model for the Airbus A320
projects.summary: Developed a six degrees of freedom flight dynamics model using MATLAB.
highlights: Modeled translational and rotational aircraft motion using rigid-body dynamics.
Integrated aerodynamic force and moment models to simulate trajectory.

projects.name: EUREKA Rocket Launch Team (LASERHAWK)
projects.summary: Programming Lead for student rocket design and launch team via NSBE.
highlights: Developed Arduino and C++ flight data logging software for a 5-foot rocket.
Enabled GPS tracking, range estimation, and post-flight data analysis.
